description: This PHP class `LDAPTestSyncService` extends `LDAPSyncService` and provides LDAP service integration for testing or synchronization purposes within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin. It manages LDAP service initialization with optional anonymous binding based on LDAP settings.

classes.name: LDAPTestSyncService
classes.description: A service class that extends LDAPSyncService for LDAP testing and synchronization, handling LDAP service setup and configuration based on provided LDAP settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LDAPTestSyncService with LDAP settings.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Provides an instance of LDAPTestService, setting credentials based on LDAP settings.

methods.name: getLDAPSetting
methods.description: Returns the LDAP configuration settings used by this service.
